caption:
Buying Como was the cheap part. 🌊

The Hartono family bought the club in Serie D in 2019 (price reported at under €1 million). Their streaming service made it a docuseries in 2021. Then Como climbed: Serie D → C → B → A (2024) → Champions League (2026).

Fàbregas joined in 2022 as a player and shareholder, was interim and assistant coach in 2023/24, and became head coach after promotion.

The owners keep paying in: €133.6M in 2024/25 alone, against €55.4M of club revenue (value of production). Those are different measures, not profit. The bet is Serie A money (€31.8M of TV rights in 2024/25) and a global brand, with a 15,200-seat stadium planned.

Sources: Como 1907 (official), The Esk (from club filings), Goal, Vavel, Antara.
